ctr_personnel.name: Proactive partnership is extremely valuableOur team has found extreme value in working shoulder to shoulder with our NG counterparts. This has alleviated multiple concerns at a lower level resulting in accelerated progress on training system development. 2. Lack of integration within NG silosWhile our peer-to-peer partnership is solid, the government has observed there is room to grow with NG collaborating with other NG product teams. Example: communication within NG is essential in providing schedule logic between segments. 3. Schedule is paramount This evaluation is based on a very early schedule and there will be continual updates. We have expectations for what future schedules will look like and with our proactive partnership we are confident that our concerns will be addressed.

data.leadership_messages: We have a great relationship with our NG counterparts; however, this is early in CA maturity leaving room for future improvement.
data.rationale: The schedule is in the early stages of development so the logic ties and details we want to evaluate are not mature. The training system is heavily dependent on the weapons system maturity and logic ties are instrumental in our evaluation. Much of the trainer scope are in high level packages that don’t provide enough detail to evaluate. We would expect our NG counterparts to hold subcontractors to same/similar standards when evaluating their schedule planning events.

areas.text: Our expectation is that we have cross-product/cross-function integration within the schedule, including the events received from subcontractors. We have not seen that in the past, so there is a lower level of confidence here.

BOE draft: Met with NG multiple times Schedule draft: Met with NG and established a meeting cadenceVSM: Met with NG and reviewed CA: Met with NG and reviewedSOW/STS-TRD: Reviewed and concurred with NG

Despite being dependent on WS maturity, we continue to work proactively with NG to effectively collaborate to empower decisions in a quick and efficient manner. NG counterparts are transparent and open to communication regarding government concerns

data.concerns: There is a concern with the current lack in logic integrating this CA to the overall Sentinel schedule. The impact of sub-contractor inputs to the schedule are currently unclear.
data.questions: Nothing additional to previously mentioned concerns.
data.integration: Too early as NG is still working through their logic.
